tagline: Engineering and Technical Services for Mission-Critical Applications
hero_kpi_rationale: Backlog is the primary indicator of future visibility for KBR, particularly within its long-term government and infrastructure segments. It is a key structural driver in technical and engineering services.

kpis.name: Total Backlog
kpis.explanation: Estimated value of signed contracts not yet billed, including proportional share of unconsolidated joint ventures.
kpis.description: Total backlog stands at $16.864 billion as of January 2, 2026, including proportional share of unconsolidated joint ventures. It includes funded and unfunded backlog, primarily within the MTS and STS segments.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Annual revenue generated from all activities.
kpis.description: Revenue of $7.786 billion in 2025, up 1% from 2024 ($7.710 billion), driven by the LinQuest acquisition and engineering services, partially offset by declines in Europe and space programs.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin improved from 8.5% in 2024 to 10.0% in 2025, driven by MTS segment growth and a one-time dispute settlement ($26M legacy claim resolution).

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Gross profit after cost of services delivered.
kpis.description: Gross margin increased from 14.3% in 2024 to 14.8% in 2025, supported by better contract execution and the impact of the LinQuest acquisition.

kpis.name: Mission Technology Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from the segment specializing in technology services for defense and intelligence.
kpis.description: The MTS segment generated $5.581 billion, representing 72% of total revenue. Growth was driven by the LinQuest acquisition and defense programs, despite declines in Europe and space programs.

kpis.name: Sustainable Technology Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue related to engineering services and sustainable energy projects.
kpis.description: The STS segment reached $2.205 billion, up 2%, driven by engineering services and equity income from LNG projects.
kpis.signal: Sustained growth in energy and engineering

kpis.name: MTS Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Operating income from the mission technology segment.
kpis.description: MTS operating income reached $463 million in 2025, up 12%, driven by LinQuest and the dispute settlement ($26M legacy claim resolution), partially offset by the loss of a non-recurring gain ($6M joint venture sale gain in 2024).

kpis.name: STS Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Operating income from the sustainable technology segment.
kpis.description: STS operating income reached $477 million in 2025, up 18%, supported by equity income from an LNG project (+$103M vs 2024).

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Total revenue of 5.767 Bn USD last fiscal year (FY2020).

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of 0.415 Bn USD last fiscal year (FY2025).

risks.title: Goodwill and Intangible Asset Impairment
risks.score_rationale: The company holds significant intangible assets from the LinQuest acquisition. Impairment could materially impact financial results. The company performed an impairment test in 2025 with no impairment identified, but this does not guarantee future impairments will not occur.

risks.title: Tax Risks from International Operations
risks.score_rationale: The company faces tax risks due to its international operations (U.K. MoD, Australian Department of Defence) and the complexity of tax laws. It has ongoing tax disputes and could be subject to fines or penalties.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to foreign exchange risks due to international operations (Europe, U.K., Australia). It uses hedging instruments to mitigate these risks, but this does not guarantee losses will not occur.

risks.title: Litigation and Legal Disputes
risks.score_rationale: The company faces litigation risks due to complex contractual activities with government clients and suppliers. It has ongoing disputes and could face fines or penalties. A recent litigation resulted in a $144M settlement in 2025.

risks.title: Pension Obligations Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company has significant pension obligations from historical operations. Assumptions used to calculate these obligations may be incorrect, potentially impacting financial results.

risks.title: Asset Impairment Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company holds significant assets that could be impaired due to changes in market conditions, geopolitical environment, or technological preferences. This could impact financial results.

risks.title: Customer Credit Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to credit risks from its relationships with government clients and suppliers. While government clients present low default risk, payment delays are possible (as observed during the 2025 government shutdown). The company uses credit risk management tools to mitigate these risks.

ai_positioning.summary: KBR has no significant mentions of AI, machine learning, or similar technologies in the provided excerpts. The company focuses on engineering services, defense technology, and energy solutions.
